content.json:
# CheckMate Health
API, frontend and infrastructure health from Application Insights, App Service and SQL logs, and Azure Monitor platform metrics.

## Health at a glance
API and browser telemetry from Application Insights. Failed requests turn orange at 1% and red at 5%; P95 response time at 1 s and 3 s.

content.query:
requests
| where timestamp {TimeRange}
| where url !endswith '/robots933456.txt'
| summarize Succeeded = countif(success == true), Failed = countif(success == false) by bin(timestamp, {TimeRange:grain})
content.title: API requests

content.query:
requests
| where timestamp {TimeRange}
| where url !endswith '/robots933456.txt'
| summarize P50 = percentile(duration, 50), P95 = percentile(duration, 95) by bin(timestamp, {TimeRange:grain})
content.title: API response time (ms)

content.query:
exceptions
| where timestamp {TimeRange}
| extend Source = iff(cloud_RoleName == "CheckMate.Web", "Browser", "API")
| summarize Exceptions = count() by Source, bin(timestamp, {TimeRange:grain})
content.title: Exceptions by source
Page views and users

content.query:
AppServicePlatformLogs
| where TimeGenerated {TimeRange}
| project TimeGenerated, Level, Message
| order by TimeGenerated desc
| take 100
content.title: App Service platform events (restarts, deployments, container starts)

content.query:
requests
| where timestamp {TimeRange}
| where url !endswith '/robots933456.txt'
| summarize Requests = count(), Failed = countif(success == false),
    ["P50 (ms)"] = round(percentile(duration, 50), 0), ["P95 (ms)"] = round(percentile(duration, 95), 0)
    by Operation = name
| extend ["Failure %"] = round(100.0 * Failed / Requests, 2)
| project Operation, Requests, Failed, ["Failure %"], ["P50 (ms)"], ["P95 (ms)"]
| order by Requests desc
content.title: Operations

content.query:
requests
| where timestamp {TimeRange}
| where url !endswith '/robots933456.txt'
| extend Status = strcat(substring(resultCode, 0, 1), "xx")
| summarize Requests = count() by Status, bin(timestamp, {TimeRange:grain})
content.title: Responses by status class

content.query:
requests
| where timestamp {TimeRange}
| where url !endswith '/robots933456.txt'
| where success == false
| summarize Failures = count(), ["Last seen"] = max(timestamp) by Operation = name, Status = resultCode
| order by Failures desc
content.title: Failed requests by operation and status
content.noDataMessage: No failed requests in this time range.

content.json:
### Database calls
SQL dependency calls made by the API. Long spikes usually mean the serverless database was resuming from auto-pause.

content.query:
dependencies
| where timestamp {TimeRange}
| where cloud_RoleName != "CheckMate.Web" and type in~ ("SQL", "mssql", "microsoft.sql_server")
| summarize Calls = count(), Failed = countif(success == false) by bin(timestamp, {TimeRange:grain})
content.title: SQL calls

content.query:
dependencies
| where timestamp {TimeRange}
| where cloud_RoleName != "CheckMate.Web" and type in~ ("SQL", "mssql", "microsoft.sql_server")
| summarize P50 = percentile(duration, 50), P95 = percentile(duration, 95), Max = max(duration) by bin(timestamp, {TimeRange:grain})
content.title: SQL call duration (ms)

content.query:
dependencies
| where timestamp {TimeRange}
| where cloud_RoleName != "CheckMate.Web"
| summarize Calls = count(), Failed = countif(success == false), ["P95 (ms)"] = round(percentile(duration, 95), 0) by Type = type, Target = target
| extend ["Failure %"] = round(100.0 * Failed / Calls, 2)
| order by Calls desc
content.title: All outgoing dependencies

content.query:
exceptions
| where timestamp {TimeRange}
| where cloud_RoleName != "CheckMate.Web"
| summarize Count = count(), ["Last seen"] = max(timestamp) by Type = type, Message = outerMessage
| order by Count desc
content.title: API exceptions
content.noDataMessage: No API exceptions in this time range.

content.query:
traces
| where timestamp {TimeRange}
| where cloud_RoleName != "CheckMate.Web" and severityLevel >= 2
| extend Severity = case(severityLevel == 2, "Warning", severityLevel == 3, "Error", "Critical")
| summarize Count = count() by Severity, bin(timestamp, {TimeRange:grain})
content.title: Warnings and errors logged

content.query:
traces
| where timestamp {TimeRange}
| where cloud_RoleName != "CheckMate.Web" and severityLevel >= 2
| extend Severity = case(severityLevel == 2, "Warning", severityLevel == 3, "Error", "Critical")
| project timestamp, Severity, Message = message, Operation = operation_Name
| order by timestamp desc
| take 200
content.title: Recent warning and error logs
content.noDataMessage: No warnings or errors logged in this time range.

content.title: Page views, users and sessions

content.query:
browserTimings
| where timestamp {TimeRange}
| summarize ["Total P50"] = percentile(totalDuration, 50), ["Total P95"] = percentile(totalDuration, 95),
    ["Network P95"] = percentile(networkDuration, 95), ["Processing P95"] = percentile(processingDuration, 95)
    by bin(timestamp, {TimeRange:grain})
content.title: Page load time (ms)

content.query:
dependencies
| where timestamp {TimeRange}
| where cloud_RoleName == "CheckMate.Web"
| summarize Calls = count(), Failed = countif(success == false) by bin(timestamp, {TimeRange:grain})
content.title: Browser calls to the API

content.query:
dependencies
| where timestamp {TimeRange}
| where cloud_RoleName == "CheckMate.Web"
| summarize P50 = percentile(duration, 50), P95 = percentile(duration, 95) by bin(timestamp, {TimeRange:grain})
content.title: Browser-observed API duration (ms)

content.query:
dependencies
| where timestamp {TimeRange}
| where cloud_RoleName == "CheckMate.Web"
| summarize Calls = count(), Failed = countif(success == false), ["P95 (ms)"] = round(percentile(duration, 95), 0) by Call = name
| extend ["Failure %"] = round(100.0 * Failed / Calls, 2)
| order by Calls desc
content.title: Browser calls by endpoint

content.query:
exceptions
| where timestamp {TimeRange}
| where cloud_RoleName == "CheckMate.Web"
| extend Kind = tostring(customDimensions.kind), Operation = tostring(customDimensions.operation)
| summarize Count = count(), Users = dcount(user_Id), ["Last seen"] = max(timestamp)
    by Kind, Operation, Type = type, Message = outerMessage
| order by Count desc
content.title: Browser exceptions
content.noDataMessage: No browser exceptions in this time range.

content.query:
customEvents
| where timestamp {TimeRange}
| where name in ("ChecklistCreated", "ChecklistUpdated", "ChecklistDeleted")
| summarize Events = count() by name, bin(timestamp, {TimeRange:grain})
content.title: Checklist activity

content.query:
pageViews
| where timestamp {TimeRange}
| summarize Views = count() by Browser = client_Browser
| order by Views desc
content.title: Browsers

content.query:
pageViews
| where timestamp {TimeRange}
| summarize Views = count() by OS = client_OS
| order by Views desc
content.title: Operating systems
App Service Plan CPU and memory %

content.query:
AppServiceHTTPLogs
| where TimeGenerated {TimeRange}
| where CsHost !contains '.scm.' and CsUriStem != '/robots933456.txt'
| summarize Requests = count() by Status = tostring(ScStatus), bin(TimeGenerated, {TimeRange:grain})
content.title: HTTP log status codes

content.query:
AppServiceHTTPLogs
| where TimeGenerated {TimeRange}
| where CsHost !contains '.scm.' and CsUriStem != '/robots933456.txt'
| summarize Requests = count(), ["P95 (ms)"] = percentile(TimeTaken, 95), ["Max (ms)"] = max(TimeTaken) by Method = CsMethod, Url = CsUriStem
| top 20 by ["P95 (ms)"] desc
content.title: Slowest URLs (HTTP logs)

content.query:
AppServiceConsoleLogs
| where TimeGenerated {TimeRange}
| where ResultDescription has "[Startup]"
| project TimeGenerated, Level, Message = ResultDescription
| order by TimeGenerated desc
| take 100
content.title: API startup log
content.noDataMessage: No API startups in this time range.

content.json:
### Azure SQL (serverless)
CPU drops to zero while the database is auto-paused. "Free amount remaining" is the free-offer vCore seconds left this month.

content.query:
AzureDiagnostics
| where TimeGenerated {TimeRange}
| where ResourceProvider == "MICROSOFT.SQL" and Category in ("Errors", "Timeouts", "Blocks", "Deadlocks")
| summarize Events = count() by Category, bin(TimeGenerated, {TimeRange:grain})
content.title: Database errors, timeouts, blocks and deadlocks

content.query:
AzureDiagnostics
| where TimeGenerated {TimeRange}
| where ResourceProvider == "MICROSOFT.SQL" and Category == "Errors"
| extend Error = toint(column_ifexists("error_number_d", real(null))),
    Severity = coalesce(toint(column_ifexists("severity_d", real(null))), toint(column_ifexists("Severity", int(null)))),
    Message = coalesce(tostring(column_ifexists("message_s", "")), tostring(column_ifexists("Message", "")))
| summarize Count = count(), ["Last seen"] = max(TimeGenerated) by Error, Severity, Message
| order by Count desc
content.title: Database errors
content.noDataMessage: No database errors in this time range.
